Swagger UI 5.33.3 (swagger-ui-dist, Apache-2.0, https://github.com/swagger-api/swagger-ui),
self-hosted static files for /api/docs: swagger-ui-bundle.js, swagger-ui.css, LICENSE, NOTICE.
